name: Add Stage Run heartbeats and stale-worker visibility
description:
Factory review recommendation 4 of 20.

## Context

Stage Runs have no last-seen time, so the supervisor hashes worktrees to infer activity.

## Acceptance criteria

- Provide a supported heartbeat/touch operation and expose last-seen time and age in Stage Run output.
- Have the supervisor refresh liveness from verified worker activity and identify stale Runs.
- Define restart and stale-worker handling while preserving ADR-0040’s lifecycle intent.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/146. Adds 'rowbly software-factory run touch', which records verified worker activity (a worker message or harness event, never polling or status) as the current Stage Run's heartbeat in the shared Run details. It refuses with CONFLICT on a changed Run, a missing or mismatched attached worker, or a Run that is not running, and with DATA_INTEGRITY on unreadable details. runs and wait gain liveness (last seen, age, stale) and --stale-after (default 15 minutes). The digest leaves out the age, so it changes once when a Run becomes stale and never just because time passes. The Stage Run tab gains a Last seen row. ADR-0048 (amends ADR-0040) says staleness only asks the supervisor to check the worker. Docs, the factory skill and the reference copies are updated. typecheck, lint, test:unit (78) and test:cli (20) pass; the suite stays at 98 tests; agentic-tui screenshots are linked from the PR.
